questions.prompt: Arrange the four stages of mitosis in the correct order:
questions.explanation: Mitosis runs Prophase → Metaphase → Anaphase → Telophase (remember: PMAT).

questions.prompt: Arrange the cell cycle stages in order, starting before division:
questions.explanation: A cell prepares in Interphase, then divides through Prophase, Metaphase, Anaphase and Telophase.

questions.prompt: Put the three parts of Interphase in order:
questions.explanation: Interphase runs G1 (growth) → S (DNA is copied) → G2 (final preparation).

questions.prompt: Arrange the levels from smallest to largest:
questions.explanation: Nucleotides build DNA; a gene is a short length of DNA; many genes sit on one chromosome.

questions.prompt: Order the steps by which a beneficial variation becomes an adaptation:
questions.explanation: This is natural selection: a helpful variation spreads over generations until it becomes an adaptation.

items: They breed and pass on the feature
A variation appears in some individuals
Over generations the whole species has it
correctOrder: A variation appears in some individuals
They breed and pass on the feature
Over generations the whole species has it

questions.prompt: Order the meiosis stages of the FIRST division:
questions.explanation: The first meiotic division runs Prophase I → Metaphase I → Anaphase I → Telophase I.

questions.prompt: Order the meiosis stages of the SECOND division:
questions.explanation: The second meiotic division runs Prophase II → Metaphase II → Anaphase II → Telophase II (no replication in Prophase II).

questions.prompt: Order these events to form a zygote:
questions.explanation: Meiosis makes haploid gametes; at fertilisation sperm and egg fuse to form a diploid zygote.

questions.prompt: Order the events during mitosis by stage:
questions.explanation: Prophase (visible) → Metaphase (line up) → Anaphase (pulled apart) → Telophase (two cells).

items: Chromosomes line up in the middle
correctOrder: Chromosomes line up in the middle
